note: Greeting card: a real ice-cream sundae with chocolate syrup, red currants, orange slices and mint, no packaging and no brand anywhere; caption transcribes both overlays verbatim and describes the rest correctly.

One post carries two declensions of the same brand -- «Вершки СЕЛЯНСЬКІ» (plural, p.2885) and «Масло СЕЛЯНСЬКЕ» (neuter, p.2888); a lexicon keyed only on «Селянське» sees one of the two. «Хрустишка» is corn sticks with a «Пряжене молоко»/«Молочні» flavour line -- dairy words on a non-dairy brand.
Homograph FP surface only: «— президент» (the office, lowercase) against canon `president`; a case-insensitive matcher fires here on a war-news post with no retail content.

Six children's worksheet sheets about watermelons; caption enumerates all six and the author signature «Олена Фоміна» correctly, and there is no food packaging, no brand and nothing dairy in any image.
Recipe naming the category generically -- «100 мл молока /або сметани», «тв. сир до 30 %» -- with zero brands: category vocabulary without a mention is the recall floor for any text-only reader here.

Six pages of pure hygiene/cosmetics (pp.15-20), no food at all; caption's category list matches. Near-miss surface only: «ЛІНІЯ КРАСИ» and «ФІТО ЛІНІЯ» soaps against canon `svoia-liniia`, plus «КРЕМ-МИЛО / CREAM SOAP» and Palmolive «Olive & Milk» -- dairy words on cosmetics.

p.31 is a whole ice-cream page and the caption names the CATEGORY («акціями на морозиво») and not one of the six brands on it -- the systematic blind spot: catalogue captions summarise aisles, so every image-only brand mention is lost. `selianske` here is «МОРОЗИВО СЕЛЯНСЬКЕ ТМ Рудь» -- the string is Рудь's ice-cream line, not the dairy ТМ Селянське, so a string matcher scores a hit on a different entity.

p.26 «МОЛОЧНІ ПРОДУКТИ» carries five watchlist brands and the caption reduces the page to «молочні продукти ... та молоко» with no brand at all. The declension to watch: «СМЕТАНА 15% ТМ ЯГОТИНСЬКА» -- feminine agreement with «сметана», while the canon lists only Яготинське/Яготинское.
Household-budget poll, no product vocabulary and no brand string of any kind -- an empty finding on both fields.

Framed portrait of a serviceman on the flag, as described; the caption omits the black mourning ribbon across the frame, so it loses that this is an obituary -- a real omission but not category-relevant, and no brands present.

The image is a photograph of the driving licence card itself (ІХС №283266, ВОЛИК Станіслав Анатолійович); the caption's own descriptive clause, «Зображення показує знайденого власника водійського посвідчення», invents a person who is not there and flips «Загублено» into «знайденого» -- the overlay text it copied is correct, the part the model wrote is not.

Homograph FP surface only: the adverb «варто» twice -- «не варто розраховувати на легке проходження», «вже зараз варто підготуватися» -- against canon `varto` (VARUS private label). A winter-preparedness post with no retail content.
Recipe with «вершковий сир» named as an ingredient and no brand behind it -- same generic-category shape as the other cooking channels in this pack.
Pancake recipe: «140 мл молока», «20 г вершкового масла» -- two dairy categories, zero brands, nothing to match.

The worst FP surface in the pack and it is politics: capitalised, declined «Президенту власну лояльність», «керівника Офісу Президента», «продемонструвати Президенту» against canon `president`, PLUS «Покладу варто було б зосередитися» against canon `varto`. Two watchlist strings, both declined, in a post about the SBU.
Parenting poll about pacifiers; no brand and no dairy vocabulary -- empty on both fields.
Protest report; the only food words are unbranded -- «зібралися неподалік із безалкогольним пивом, квасом, напоями та сиром» -- so «сиром» is a category token on a news post, not a mention.

A retail promo whose brands are all glassware -- Yorkshire, Fiora, Flamberg, Pasabahce, Maxmark, Smart Kitchen -- and whose category word is «Форми для морозива»: an ice-cream token on a homeware SKU, the FP shape a keyword pre-filter would let through as retail-relevant.
